decisions.reason: As a large growing German machinery firm with in-house R&D, we would keep this workstation because it extends our established identification portfolio, has already received market-facing commitment, and there is no clear evidence yet that any weak early uptake is more than a temporary launch effect.

We would keep this thermal inkjet printer because it is close to our core offer, publicly committed with its own product page, supported by our stated strategy of integrated coding solutions, and sunk development and launch costs make withdrawal hard to justify so early.

We would keep this piezo inkjet printer because it fits our announced direction toward broader production-line identification, reflects visible commitment and likely meaningful R&D investment, and in a favorable industry environment management would attribute any initial shortcomings to normal market ramp-up rather than a reason to exit.
